data.text:
The coverage record just written reports 100.0 with a delta of 0.0, and neither
figure was measured on this attempt. `harness/coverage.py:19` builds the command
as `pnpm --filter @seen/core test -- --coverage.enabled --coverage.reporter=json-summary`,
and pnpm forwards the `--` itself, so vitest runs as `vitest run -- --coverage.enabled
--coverage.reporter=json-summary` and reads the two flags as positional filters
rather than as options. Coverage is therefore never enabled, no summary is written,
and the gate reads whatever `packages/core/coverage/coverage-summary.json` already
held. That file is dated 27 September and covers one path, `packages/core/src/index.ts`,
five lines of placeholder. It does not measure `packages/core/db/` at all, which is
where every line SEEN-008 wrote lives.

So the figure is true about a file this ticket did not touch, and says nothing about
the file it did. It is recorded here rather than corrected here: the defect is in the
harness and not in the schema, and SEEN-008 is not the ticket to fix it in. The
delta of 0.0 is honest only in the sense that a number compared with itself cannot move.

This is the third defect SEEN-112's proof run surfaced in the harness rather than in
the ticket it was proving, after the guard that stops guarding during rework and the
guard that cannot express a directory. All three want one harness ticket.
